blocks.text: LIST OF COUNCIL OF MINISTERS AS ON 6TH AUGUST, 1990.

blocks.html:
1.Shri Vishwanath Pratap SinghPrime Minister and alsoincharge of the Ministries/Departments of Defence;Personnel; Public Grievancesand Pensions; Science &Technology; Atomic Energy;Electronics; OceanDevelopment; Space andother subjects not allocatedto any other CabinetMinister or Minister ofState (Independent charge).
2.Prof. Madhu DandavateMinister of Finance.
3.Shri Mufti Mohammad SayeedMinister of Home Affairs.
4.Shri Ajit SinghMinister of Industry.
5.Shri Arun Kumar NehruMinister of Commerce andTourism.
6.Shri I.K. GujralMinister of ExternalAffairs.
7.Shri George FernandesMinister of Railways.
8.Shri Sharad YadavMinister of Textiles withadditional charge of theMinistry of Food ProcessingIndustries.
9.Shri Arif Mohd. KhanMinister of Energy withadditional charge of theMinistry of Civil Aviation.
10.Shri M.S. GurupadaswamyMinister of Petroleum andChemicals.
11.Shri K.P. UnnikrishnanMinister of SurfaceTransport.
12.Shri Dinesh GoswamiMinister of Steel and Mineswith additional charge ofthe Ministry of Law andJustice.
13.Shri Murasoli MaranMinister of UrbanDevelopment.
14.Shri Nathu Ram MirdhaMinister of Food and CivilSupplies.
15.Shri Nilamani RoutrayMinister of Environment andForests.
